content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Associate-I positions is 25th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the ANRF Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech/M.S./MCA/M.Sc. degree with a valid GATE qualification (in CS, DA, EC, or EE) or NET qualification (in Computer Science and Applications, Electronic Science, and Mathematical Sciences).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ANRF Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ANRF Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the norms of the Government of India/IIT (ISM), Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the ANRF Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The salary for the ANRF Project Associate-I position is ₹37,000 per month for candidates who are GATE/NET qualified, and ₹30,000 per month for those who are not GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the ANRF Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the ANRF Project Associate-I post at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ANRF Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ANRF Project Associate-I recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the ANRF Project Associate-I position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Project Associate-I recruitment must be submitted online only.
